scope: Simple pair bench inside the full game with a loaded save (original with the function hook off vs candidate with the hook on), 4096 isolated CPU pairs for 9 functions of CPopulation, ALL pairs equal, pair counts equal to the bank table, passed=true globally, natural "complete" event with state_restored and layout_ok, saves unchanged, configs restored. Each case rebuilds the same deterministic fixture (seed = case index) in both legs and compares the return value, the bytes of the fake objects, the touched global ranges, the x87 control word (24 bits) and the whole trace of doubled collaborators with raw arguments; foreign threads ignored. Traced doubles get NO credit. Only the own part of each function is validated. Source tested == current working tree at registration (class sources match the probe build manifest). Historical evidence approved with explicit limits; no current dependency accreditation. Padding and uninitialised bytes masked. Bank limits (PopFinal4): CPed::operator new (0x5E4720), CVehicle::operator new (0x6E2D50) and CTask::operator new (0x61A5A0) return holes of own buffers filled with 0xCD (fake buffers, not real pool objects); the constructors of CCivilianPed (0x5DDB70), CCopPed (0x5DDC60), CEmergencyPed (0x5DE340) and CAutomobile (0x6B0A90) are doubled in the EXE and in the DLL (they set only the fields read afterwards: vtable, model, type, intelligence, matrix, clump type 2), so they get no credit; stack tasks and events are REAL (EXE and DLL constructors/destructors) with CTaskManager::SetTask (0x681AF0) and CEventGroup::Add (0x4AB420) doubled and traced (type and words written; unwritten 0xCD arena bytes masked; in events only the fields 0x10/0x12/0x14/0x18 and 0x1C/0x20 of the attractor); world, camera, ground, collisions, paths, weapons, intelligence, streaming and the CPopulation functions each case does not test are doubled with traces and get no credit; ThePaths and the sector lists 0xB992B8 (3072 bytes), pool headers and every touched global are backed up and restored per case; CMatrix::operator* and CPed::SetHeading run undoubled (identity matrices / ped without matrix). Fixture domain: model ids 0..319 only (PedMICanBeCreatedAtThisAttractor reads [mi+0x28] without a null check, 0x61120C); PopulateInterior numPeds <= 6 (the EXE dereferences the ped returned by AddPed without a null check, 0x6165A2); the 2D effect is of attractor type (EFFECT_ATTRACTOR=3). Limits are declared per function in the function-specific scope and in the bank README. Revalidado el 2026-11-04 tras reconstruir colaboradores (lotes 67 a 89 y anteriores); el banco se adapto a ellos: falsos identicos en la direccion del EXE y en el cuerpo/simbolo de la DLL (ver su README.md).
